in_sanskrit.name: Monesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon, God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Mona’ meaning moon and ‘Ish’ meaning god. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Shiva, who is often depicted with a crescent moon on his forehead.

in_marathi.name: Monesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Monesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Mona’ meaning moon and ‘Ish’ meaning god. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Shiva, who is often depicted with a crescent moon on his forehead.

in_bengali.name: Monesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon, God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Monesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Mona’ meaning moon and ‘Ish’ meaning god. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Shiva, who is often depicted with a crescent moon on his forehead.
